The name

A great, fertile land

“Coabana” comes from the Taíno language: a great place of fertile land — one of the attributed origins of the name of Cuba. We like to think about data the same way: land that produces when it is well cultivated.

Coabana is a studio founded by Roanny Lamas, a Data Engineer specialized in Google Cloud. We offer end-to-end data engineering services: from the initial architecture to the day-to-day operation of your platform.

🌴

Caribbean roots, global standards

Warm and clear in communication; rigorous engineering in every build.

🎯

Specialists, not generalists

We do one thing: data platforms on Google Cloud. And we do it well.

🔁

End to end

From the first architecture conversation to monitoring in production.

Services

What Coabana does for your data

Clear engagements with concrete deliverables — from a focused advisory session to the full platform.

🏝️

Data platforms on BigQuery

Design and build of your warehouse or lakehouse: layered modeling, open formats with BigLake, security, and costs under control from day one.

  • Datastream

Tooling

The Google Cloud data portfolio, up to date

From ingestion to agents, the services we build with — and what each one is for.

Ingestion

  • Pub/Submessaging and events
  • DatastreamCDC and continuous replication
  • Storage Transfer Servicebulk transfers

Processing

  • Dataflowbatch and streaming (Apache Beam)
  • DataprocSpark and the Hadoop ecosystem
  • DataformELT with versioned SQL

Warehouse & lakehouse

  • BigQuerythe analytical core
  • BigLakelakehouse and open formats
  • Cloud Storagedata lake

Orchestration

  • Cloud Composermanaged Airflow
  • Workflowsserverless orchestration
  • Cloud Schedulermanaged cron

Governance

  • Knowledge Catalogcatalog, lineage and quality formerly Dataplex Universal Catalog
  • Sensitive Data Protectionclassification, masking and de-identification formerly Cloud DLP

BI & visualization

  • LookerBI and semantic layer
  • Data Studioself-service dashboards formerly Looker Studio

AI & agents

  • Gemini Enterprise Agent Platformend-to-end agents and ML formerly Vertex AI
  • Gemini Enterpriseenterprise assistant and search
  • BigQuery MLmachine learning with SQL

Yes, some of these just changed names again. Staying current is part of the service.

Method

How we work

  1. 01

    Discovery

    We understand your business, your sources and the decision you want to enable. No jargon, measurable goals.

  2. 02

    Architecture

    Platform design and a phased plan, with Google Cloud cost estimates before writing a single line.

  3. 03

    Build

    Short iterations with usable deliveries: infrastructure as code, CI/CD and documentation from the start.

  4. 04

    Operate & evolve

    Monitoring, cost optimization and coaching for your team so the platform lives and grows.

Behind Coabana

We work end to end: architecture, pipelines, governance, BI and agents. If your project lives on Google Cloud — or wants to move there — let's talk.
